name: get_host_shell
description: Return the host shell executable, default working directory, and capability status.

name: run_host_shell
description: Run a command as the service account in a fresh, noninteractive /bin/sh on Ivenna's host, with no terminal or live stdin. Waits for completion or timeout, then stops processes remaining in the invocation's process group. Returns the process outcome, stdout content, stderr diagnostics, and paths to full output logs. Each text preview is limited to 16 KiB; JPEG, PNG, GIF, and WebP stdout is returned as native image content. Image data over 32 MiB and content detected as unsupported return diagnostics.

cwd.description: Working directory, absolute or relative to the service startup directory. Omit to use the service startup directory.

timeout_ms.description: Command timeout in milliseconds. Omit for 600000 (10 minutes).

representation.description: Image representation; omit for data. url passes the entire nonempty text unchanged as one image URL, without fetching or validating the address. Image bytes remain image data.

expected.description: Expected stdout content; omit for auto. Actual content determines the result without conversion or requiring a match. Does not apply to stderr.

name: browse_memory_room
description: Explore a memory room and discover its child rooms and memory entries. Rooms persist across sessions; choose their organization freely. The result contains room and entries; each entry has address, name, and kind (room or memory).

room.description: The room location, relative to the shared entrance. Omit to use the entrance, ".".

name: find_memory
description: Find memory entries and rooms by name within a room and its descendants. Use recall_memory to search remembered content. The result contains room, query, and matches; each match has address, name, and kind. No matches returns an empty matches list.

query.description: The name or name pattern to find. Literal mode matches part of a name.

room.description: The room location, relative to the shared entrance. Omit to use the entrance, ".".

match_mode.description: Interpret query as literal text (default), a glob such as "*.md", or a regular expression.

case_sensitive.description: Match upper and lower case exactly. Omit to ignore case.

name: recall_memory
description: Search memory entries for a clue within a room and its descendants. The result contains room, clue, and matches; each match has address, line, and text. Use a matching address to read the full entry. No matches returns an empty matches list.

clue.description: The text or pattern to find in memory entries.

room.description: The room location, relative to the shared entrance. Omit to use the entrance, ".".

match_mode.description: Interpret clue as literal text (default) or a regular expression.

case_sensitive.description: Match upper and lower case exactly. Omit to ignore case.

name: read_memory
description: Read a memory entry at a known location. Returns its address and full text, or image metadata with native JPEG, PNG, GIF, or WebP content. Unsupported content or image data over 32 MiB returns a diagnostic.

address.description: The memory entry location, relative to the shared entrance.

representation.description: Image representation; omit for data. url passes the entire nonempty text unchanged as one image URL, without fetching or validating the address. Image bytes remain image data.

expected.description: Expected entry content; omit for auto. Actual content determines the result without conversion or requiring a match.

name: remember
description: Write text to a memory entry. The result contains address.

address.description: The location for the memory entry, relative to the shared entrance.

content.description: Text to keep in this entry.

mode.description: create (default) fails if the address already exists; append adds text without inserting a separator; replace overwrites the entry. append and replace also create missing entries. create and append require an existing containing room; replace also creates missing parent rooms.

name: revise_memory
description: Revise matching text in an existing memory entry. The result contains address and revision (no_match, unchanged, or revised).

address.description: The memory entry location, relative to the shared entrance.

old_text.description: The text to match, or a regular expression when match_mode is regex.

new_text.description: The replacement text. Regex mode expands captures such as ${1} and ${name}; literal mode keeps this text as supplied.

replace_all.description: Replace every match. Omit to replace only the first.

match_mode.description: Interpret old_text as literal text (default) or a regular expression. Literal matching is case-sensitive; a regex can set inline flags.

name: create_memory_room
description: Create a room to organize memory entries and child rooms. Parent rooms are created as needed, and an existing room can be reused. The result contains address.

address.description: The new room location, relative to the shared entrance.

name: move_memory
description: Move or rename a memory entry or a room and its contents. An occupied target is reported as an error. The result contains the actual new address. References in memory content are not rewritten automatically.

address.description: The location of a memory entry or room, relative to the shared entrance.

destination.description: The new location, or an existing room to move into. Both are relative to the shared entrance.

name: forget_memory
description: Remove a memory entry or an empty room. The shared entrance is retained. The result contains address.

address.description: The location of a memory entry or room, relative to the shared entrance.

recursive.description: Remove all entries and child rooms at this location. Omit to remove only an entry or an empty room.

name: wait_for_input
description: Request a pause when this tool batch finishes and no input is queued. New input or an explicit resume continues the same session and history.
